discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.text: We listen to your idea, understand the problem and define the scope before writing a line of code.

design.title: Design
design.text: We prototype the screens and the flow with you, to validate the experience before building it.

development.title: Development
development.text: We build in short cycles with frequent deliveries, so you see real progress and can adjust.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: We deploy, document and walk with you through the first steps with your product in production.
